passages.title: 32번 지문
passages.text: Of the cognitive motivations, the most fundamental one encourages people to understand their environment to predict what is going to happen in case of uncertainties. Most important, people prefer to develop meanings that are shared with other people. For example, if in a given year more people accept offers of admission than a college expects, quite a few students end up living in dorm lounges or campus hotels. It is easy to understand why living in the lounge is problematic (no closet, for one thing). But what is wrong with a room at campus hotels? After all, students in a hotel get private bathrooms, their own TV, and larger rooms. In fact, living in those hotels is problematic because the student residents are not a part of a stable group with people who will be their neighbors for the year; they must wait in uncertainty before finding their social niche. The uncertainty itself is the problem. People lack a shared social understanding, normally developed from membership in a stable group.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Comfort and amenities are the most important factors in student housing satisfaction.
People are fundamentally motivated to reduce uncertainty by forming shared social understanding within stable groups.
Colleges should always avoid admitting more students than they can house.
Hotel rooms are objectively worse than dorm lounges in every respect.
Waiting periods before finding a social niche have no effect on well-being.
questions.explanation: 글의 핵심은 안정된 집단 속에서 공유된 이해를 형성함으로써 불확실성을 줄이려는 것이 근본적 동기라는 것이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: The most fundamental cognitive motivation helps people predict what will happen in uncertain situations.
Students in campus hotels have private bathrooms, their own TV, and larger rooms than those in dorm lounges.
Living in a hotel is more socially stable than living in a dorm lounge because hotel guests share a fixed community.
People generally prefer meanings that are shared with others.
The uncertainty of not belonging to a stable group is itself identified as the central problem.
questions.explanation: 호텔 거주 학생들은 한 해 동안 이웃이 될 안정된 집단에 속하지 못하므로 오히려 불안정하다고 했으므로 ③은 반대된다.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장들을 논리적 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열하시오. (순서배열·문장삽입 동시 훈련용)
